title: Commodity Trading Manager
Identify_Pain__c: I already shared our Wheat and Soymeal sample report, i included his researcher Najaf Valiyev. I spoke with Murad, the Commodity Trading Manager. The business both buys and sells agricultural commodities, though it is primarily buy-side. They mainly buy wheat from Russia and sell into Kazakhstan, and if they have remaining volume, they also sell onward. They also buy soymeal from Argentina. They have an internal researcher who gathers market data and produces in-house reports. At the moment, they use Platts for reference pricing and market information, but Murad said it is not particularly good for their needs. His view was that it is too basic and too broad, and not specific enough to the regions they care about. Their main interest is in coverage across the Black Sea, the Americas, and the EU. Murad’s team consists of nine people in total, each responsible for different commodities. He indicated they trade around 2,000 MT per month. The fact that they are already using Platts suggests there is a real use case and an existing budget line for external market intelligence.
